notice: Every fixture in this directory is a synthetic, hand-authored HTML snippet — none are real VLR.gg captures, and no live VLR.gg page was ever committed to this repository. As of TASK-042, each fixture's structure (element classes, nesting, attributes) was rewritten to match real vlr.gg markup verified during a bounded live-request session (events index, event detail x3, event match-list, match detail, team page) whose raw responses were held only in the gitignored services/vlr-ingestion/.local/raw-inspect/ scratch directory and never committed. Content (team/event names, IDs, scores) remains fabricated/placeholder — only the structural shape is real-derived. See docs/30-vlr-historical-backfill.md ('Real markup verification') for the full comparison.

team-page.html.purpose: Team page parser happy path: name (h1, distinct from the nested tag), short tag, country, logo, roster.

event-discovery-page.html.purpose: Event discovery/listing page (.events-container / a.event-item) with a deliberate duplicate entry to test dedup.

event-page-vct-americas.html.purpose: Event classified as an approved VCT region (Americas) via the real breadcrumb stage+region tag structure.

event-page-masters.html.purpose: Event classified as Masters via the real breadcrumb stage tag reading literally 'Masters'.

event-page-champions.html.purpose: Event classified as Champions via the real breadcrumb shape (no stage tag, multiple region tags, title says Champions not Champions Tour).

event-page-excluded-tier2.html.purpose: Challengers event excluded as tier-2 by name, even though it shares the same VCT breadcrumb structure as an approved league event.

event-page-excluded-game-changers.html.purpose: Event excluded as Game Changers via name pattern, under its own (non-VCT) breadcrumb.

event-page-excluded-showmatch.html.purpose: Event excluded as a showmatch via name pattern, under an unrelated breadcrumb.

event-page-unknown.html.purpose: Event with no classifiable evidence; must resolve to unknown, never an approved family.

match-list-page.html.purpose: Match list page for one event (day-heading + a.match-item cards, no team ID present), with a deliberate duplicate match link to test dedup.

match-completed.html.purpose: Completed match with a full 3-map Bo3 result (gamesnav + vm-stats-game join), attack/defense splits, an overtime map, and a 10-player aggregate roster table.

match-completed-2.html.purpose: Second completed match (2-0), referenced by match-list-page.html's second entry, for end-to-end ingestion tests.

match-scheduled.html.purpose: Upcoming/scheduled match with no map results yet; status inferred from the presence of a scheduled timestamp with no 'final'/'LIVE' note.

match-missing-fields.html.purpose: Completed match with several genuinely optional fields absent (series format, patch, attack/defense splits).

match-malformed.html.purpose: Malformed page missing the match header entirely, to prove the parser fails loudly instead of returning a silently empty record.

match-postponed.html.purpose: Postponed match with no map results; real markup has no postponed signal of its own, so this exercises the required statusHint path.
